label: wolves-disable

changes: SceneSetup.Game.Wildlife.cs: added `private const bool WolvesEnabled = false;`. Wrapped the 3-wolf spawn block in `if (WolvesEnabled)`. Deer/Boar/Chicken/Rabbit (14 animals) untouched.

AIDirector.cs: added `public const bool WolvesEnabled = false;`. Wrapped the `wolf_pack` GameEvent pool.Add in `if (WolvesEnabled)` inside BuildDefaultPool, so the wolf threat event is never fired and PlayWolfHowl (gated by next.id=='wolf_pack') is never reached. result: With WolvesEnabled=false on both gates, no Wolf GameObject is created and no wolf_pack event fires. Wolves absent from game/map. Set both constants to true to revive.
